title: Sleepy little dragon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='50%' cy='40%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7ef0a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3fc47a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail curling around -->
  <path d='M28 78 Q18 80 16 70 Q15 62 24 60 Q30 59 34 64' fill='none' stroke='#3fc47a' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M16 70 Q14 63 20 62' fill='#9df5c0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='25' ry='18' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#d8ffe8'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M32 56 L36 48 L41 56 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M44 52 L49 43 L54 52 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M57 52 L62 43 L67 52 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- wings folded -->
  <path d='M30 66 Q18 58 22 70 Q26 78 38 76 Z' fill='#5fd98f'/>
  <path d='M70 66 Q82 58 78 70 Q74 78 62 76 Z' fill='#5fd98f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='22' ry='19' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#5fd98f'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='49' r='1.6' fill='#2a9c5c'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='49' r='1.6' fill='#2a9c5c'/>
  <!-- eyes closed happy -->
  <path d='M37 36 Q41 40 45 36' fill='none' stroke='#1f7f4a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 36 Q59 40 63 36' fill='none' stroke='#1f7f4a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='44' rx='4' ry='2.8' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='44' rx='4' ry='2.8' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <!-- sleepy mouth -->
  <path d='M46 53 Q50 56 54 53' fill='none' stroke='#2a9c5c' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M36 24 Q32 14 40 16 Q40 22 42 26 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M64 24 Q68 14 60 16 Q60 22 58 26 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- little zzz -->
  <path d='M74 22 L82 22 L74 30 L84 30' fill='none' stroke='#bfe9ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M64 14 L70 14 L64 20 L70 20' fill='none' stroke='#bfe9ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
